description: Clinical trials recruiting now for a condition, from ClinicalTrials.gov: title, phase, sponsor, who can join (age, sex, healthy volunteers), the nearest recruiting site and its distance, and the study page. Send the place's latitude and longitude (you work them out) to search within a radius, and an age to keep only trials that accept it. Use when someone or a family member is looking for trial options. Not medical advice. Not for a medicine's label, recalls or cost (use check_medicine).

condition.description: Condition, e.g. 'type 1 diabetes', 'early-stage triple negative breast cancer'

intervention.description: A drug or treatment to narrow to, e.g. 'pembrolizumab'

place.description: Name of the place, for the answer

name: check_trials
title: Trials check: clinical trials recruiting near you
